scripts.android:sync: npm run build:native && cap sync android
scripts.android:build:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.test: esbuild src/preferences.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/duo-preferences-test.mjs && esbuild src/runtime.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=/tmp/duo-runtime-test.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
